    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator

    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity.
        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized

    Return:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.

    Mathematical function representing acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator system.
    
    Args:
        x: Observations of current position.
        v: Observations of velocity.
        params: An array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized:
            0: Natural frequency (rad/s)
            1: Frequency damping coefficient (s^-1)
            2: Amplitude of the driving force (unit-dependent)
            3: Frequency of the driving force (rad/s)
            4: Phase angle of the driving force (radians)
            5: Direct influence term of interaction.
    
    Returns:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as a result of the mathematical function.
    """

    natural_freq = params[1]  # Natural frequency of the oscillator (generic for non-driven condition)
    driving_force_amp = params[2]  # Amplitude of driving force
    freq_for_driving = params[3] # Frequency of driving force (generic for all instances)
